title: docs(skills): the formula skill says the build refuses date subtraction (`end - start`)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xUVqqk5nMQrFBKFQ5V87Lo5)_

Fixes #29061
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Blocked-by: #29058

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:formula 技能的「No date arithmetic」说明改为:构建拒收 `date + n` 和 `end - start`(日期或日期时间相减、`today()`/`now()` 减日期字段),处方是 `daysBetween(a, b)`;Want/Write 表不动。dashboards 规则、两个 eval 里写成日期相减的请假天数公式与说明同步改掉。
- 为什么改:#29058 让公式门禁拒收日期相减;旧说明写着 `end - start`「不报错、得到存成 `{}` 的 duration」,会教 AI 写出构建不过的公式。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字与 eval 文字,无代码;行数不变,token 净增 +26(两个受棘轮文件仍在上限内,上限未动)。必须在 #29058 合并后再落地,否则技能说的拒收在 main 上还不成立。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` 第 151-153 行的说明;② `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` 第 100 行;③ 两个 eval 的一行改动。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 全绿,`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` 为 5686/5997。
- 需要你做的:#29058 合并后,审批并合并本 PR(Tier H `skills/**`)。

## What changes

Text only, inside the claim's file surface. The wording follows PR #29058 at head `e029ea772b1555ea33b2946e0978ff4175dbdd3e` (its gate in `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`, its refusal messages, its changeset and its new row in `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`).

- `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, the "No date arithmetic" note. It said `end - start` "does not fault — it yields a `duration` stored as `{}`". It now says the build refuses both `date + n` and `end - start`: a date or date-time mixed with a number, or minus another, reads `null`, and `today()` / `now()` minus a date field reads `{}`. It prescribes `daysBetween(a, b)`. The Want / Write table is unchanged.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json`, eval 6. The stored `days_requested` formula is restated from `end_date - start_date` to `daysBetween(record.start_date, record.end_date)`. Its only `must_contain` token, `number`, is unchanged and still taught by the skill.
- Item 3 sweep (`skills/**`, then `content/docs/**`), two more hits, both fixed here:
  - `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` line 100 described the same leave-days formula as `` `days_requested` (`end - start`) ``. It now reads `` (`daysBetween(start, end)`) ``. The rule it teaches (never `sum` a formula) is unchanged.
  - `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` eval 4 explained `record.close_date - today()` as "a duration stored as `{}`", which reads as a shape that builds. It now says "the build refuses it". Assertions unchanged.
  - Outside `skills/**`: `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` is updated by #29058 itself; `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx` line 726 is release history and stays as written. No other `content/docs/**` text subtracts dates in a formula.
- `.changeset/29061-formula-skill-date-subtraction-refused.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

No ceiling moved and no line was re-wrapped.

## Tests

No code changes. The claims in the new text were checked against the gate itself, by calling `validateExpression('value', …)` from a built `@objectstack/formula`, once at #29058's head (with this commit cherry-picked on top) and once at `origin/main` `a4015ab4`:

<details><summary>#29058 head refuses every shape the note names and accepts every daysBetween shape; origin/main accepts the subtractions</summary>

```
-- #29058 head e029ea77
REFUSED date-arithmetic          record.d + 1
REFUSED date-text-arithmetic     record.end_date - record.start_date
REFUSED date-text-arithmetic     record.end_at - record.start_at
REFUSED date-duration-value      today() - record.start_date
REFUSED date-duration-value      now() - record.start_at
REFUSED date-duration-value      record.close_date - today()
accepted                         daysBetween(record.start_date, record.end_date)
accepted                         daysBetween(record.start_date, record.end_date) + 1
accepted                         daysBetween(today(), record.close_date)
-- origin/main a4015ab4
REFUSED date-arithmetic          record.d + 1
accepted                         record.end_date - record.start_date
accepted                         record.end_at - record.start_at
accepted                         today() - record.start_date
accepted                         now() - record.start_at
accepted                         record.close_date - today()
accepted                         daysBetween(record.start_date, record.end_date)
accepted                         daysBetween(record.start_date, record.end_date) + 1
accepted                         daysBetween(today(), record.close_date)
```

</details>

The `origin/main` half is why this PR is `Blocked-by: #29058`: before that lands, the note would describe a refusal `main` does not make.

`check:doc-formula-expressions` (it judges the formula examples in `skills/**` with the built `@objectstack/formula`) is green on both trees: on this branch at `a36bf3ab`, and on #29058's head with this commit cherry-picked (25 record-scoped examples across 548 files judged clean).

## Acceptance notes

- The note says "never `end - start`" without carving out predicates. #29058 still accepts a condition that compares a duration (`today() - record.start_date > duration("72h")`). The skill keeps the simpler rule, which is never wrong for a formula; adding the carve-out would cost tokens for an edge the formula skill does not teach.
- If #29058's head moves before it merges, this PR re-reads it.
